title: packages: refuse an address-literal namespace at build time, and name an installed one in the upgrade report (G1 #31691 follow-up)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPF1skfu2kx89BEXZi

Filing gate: ④ follow-up node of #31691 (G1, epic #31527), from the epic seat's red-line R1 on PR #31959 and the seat's delta record (issuecomment-6747181533, ③). It is not a claim.
Business reason: G1 part (a) refuses a package namespace that spells an address literal (`actions`, `connectors`, `global`, `hooks`, `oauth`, `trigger`) only at the running install door, and at an upgrade that moves a namespace onto one. A package the boot registers keeps booting with one warning, so a deployment that already holds one does not break on upgrade. Two gaps remain. A code-shipped package that is new to a deployment is never refused, only warned at boot. And an operator learns of an installed one only from a log line.
Reader: the next `domain:server` seat, after PR #31959 merges (same registry code).
Dedupe: no open or closed card names `validateNamespaceNotAddressLiteral` outside #31691, or an upgrade-report finding for a literal namespace.
class: c · type: Tech debt
Grade: p2. Nothing first-party uses one of the six namespaces. The gaps reach only third-party packages.

## 维护者速读

G1（#31691）第一部分让运行中的安装入口拒绝拼成路由字面量的命名空间。已安装的包照常启动，只打一条警告，靠 `?package=` 读取。还差两件事：构建时（`defineStack` / `os validate`）就拒绝新包用这六个命名空间；在升级报告里点名已安装的这类包，让运维看得到，而不只是日志。

## What to build

1. **Build-time refusal.** Have `defineStack` (spec `validateNamespacePrefix`) and the CLI `os validate` / build refuse a stack whose namespace is one of the six, through the existing `validateNamespaceNotAddressLiteral` (spec/kernel). The message names the literal and the rename remedy. A `packages/spec` change is in scope for this one call only.
2. **Upgrade-report finding.** Once an upgrade-report findings seam exists (ADR-0150 D10, or S4's `os migrate stored-references`), name each installed package whose namespace is a literal: its id, the literal, that its items are read with `?package=<id>`, and that a rename gives it the qualified path. If no seam exists when this card is picked up, do item 1 alone, and carry item 2 to the card that builds the seam.

## Acceptance

- Item 1 is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, a refusal at build time with `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` (an author-written value newly refused). That means a `minor` changeset with the FROM → TO fix. The first-party census is expected to be zero.
- The boot exemption and the install-door pins in `registry-namespace-address-literal.test.ts` stay green.
- Item 2 is pinned with a held `hooks` package named in the report.
